phreshphish.source: Dalton et al. (2025), PhreshPhish, arXiv preprint DOI 10.48550/arxiv.2507.10854; dataset v1.0.1
phreshphish.licence: CC BY 4.0; additional dataset-card research-use statement
phreshphish.quote: should only be used for anti-phishing research
phreshphish.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 permits sharing subject to attribution; comply with the card research-use statement. Project policy: do not commit this dataset.
phreshphish.reproduce: Stored outside data/raw, only under ignored data/external/phreshphish/. Download only url, label, target, date, lang with data/scripts/download_phreshphish.py. data/phreshphish-lock.json pins revision, upstream-declared SHA-256 and independently measured selected-range/projected-file SHA-256. HTML column data is never downloaded by this script. Original whole-file hashes are not locally verified because whole-file downloading would retrieve HTML. Card test counts differ by 76; benign URL source is not stated.
